title: Trimmy: a tiny macOS menu bar app with one job: Paste once, run once.  #github

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: You know those multi-line shell commands you copy from docs, blogs, or chatgpt and then they don't paste cleanly into your terminal? Yeah, Trimmy fixes that. Trim is a tiny Mac OS menu bar app with one job. Paste once, run once. It automatically flattens messy multi-line shell snippets into a clean singleline command that actually runs. There are optional toggles too like keeping intentional blank lines, stripping box drawing characters from fancy prompts.
